covers.why: nothing is out of reach: nothing over the copies counts
all that meets the copy out of reach, by type and id, itself left out
the header is not over the other copy

verdicts.why: copies that stand as asked are not asked of again, a few points off either
a carousel that never stops, elsewhere at every read, is not asked of at any
copies come to rest at a new place are asked of once, when a later read has them there still
one read looked at twice is no proof of standing still
a settle that found the screen still is proof at once
a cover that left is asked of, the copies in place
a copy of another size has moved
slides read on their way and back at rest, as between a carousel's turns, are known where they were asked of

sameDigest.why: a plain text's width follows its text

sameLayout.why: text width and a small move
what is not shown does not count

points.why: a touch passes through a plain overlay to the button

scrollBars.why: a named node, or one with something named inside, is the app's
as thin as a bar goes, and as far from the edge

told by a percentage for their value in any language, wherever they stand inside what scrolls: 117 pt over a sheet's bottom, in a wrapper, in a link, shortened by a keyboard; not a gauge, a bar with an id, one in nothing that scrolls, nor a value with digits apart

settleTraces.why: the first read is held to what the caller saw
a first read with nothing to hold it to proves nothing
a change starts the count again, from when that read began
busy holds it, however still the screen
the deadline ends it, unsettled, and the last sleep stops at it

regions.why: within what counts as one place
a text of another width is no change
a button moved far from where it was
the banner and a button far from it
a view over half the screen is the screen
slides with no view of their own: the strip they lie in, by what they are
a line that comes inside the strip is not of it
nor on a screen with no slides
the slides and a button far from them

cyclingTraces.why: a part that keeps moving is a change until it has moved longer than a transition lasts, and none from then
a change anywhere else is one though the part is known
a slide under one part that ends is never known to cycle
a gap is from the end of one read to the start of the next: reads that take long are no gap
steps too far apart leave the settle its quiet window, and are never known
a part not seen moving for long is known no longer
what an action of ours set moving is waited out however long, and reads of it make nothing known
a part known stays so through an action of ours
